program='''def transform(grid):
    """Vertically align each nonzero color object to the highest occupied row."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = min(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) for v in row if v != 0)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        object_top = min(r for r, c in cells)
        shift = top - object_top
        for r, c in cells:
            nr = r + shift
            if 0 <= nr < h:
                out[nr][c] = color
    return out
'''
